nightly-eval-bot: [ALERT] nightly-evals failed for model redwood/model-x-quant8@v2
suites failed: qna-bench-v2 (2/10 seeds failed), codegen-smoke (1/5), chit-chat-regression (3/8)
failure delta vs baseline: qna-bench-v2 +6.8% error rate
dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/evals/1767654321
run_id: nightly-176765

Maya: ack — severity and owners?

Liam: looks like qna-bench is the biggest hit. I'm +1 to P1 since qna failure >5% and impacts API gen traffic.

Anita: I'll take ownership of qna-bench triage. Starting with repro + compare quant vs fp16.

Maya: thanks. can you re-run with seeds 12-16? quick command: `./tools/eval_run --suite qna-bench-v2 --model redwood/model-x-quant8@v2 --seeds 12-16 --out /tmp/rerun.json`

Anita: running now... initial log snippet:
```
seed=12: pass_rate=0.77
seed=13: pass_rate=0.74
baseline_fp16=0.83
diff = -0.09
```
Looks like a consistent drop across seeds.

Liam: maybe quantization/kv-cache mismatch. @ops-bot can you check if runtime kernel flags changed on the GPU fleet yesterday?

ops-bot: No kernel flag changes in prod since last deploy. Noted increased scheduling churn at ~03:12 UTC — investigating.

Maya: another idea: were we routing to smaller batch machines last night? @infra-runner

infra-runner: traffic shows model pinned to g4dn.x8 last night for reserved pools; no config change detected.

Anita: cross-compare against model-x-fp16@v2 results:
```
model-x-fp16 pass_rate = 0.82
model-x-quant8 pass_rate = 0.74
```
Quant gap ~8% — looks like quantization introduced a quality regression.

Liam: assign to ML-quant team. Owners: @Liam, @Anita. Severity: P1. Immediate mitigation: revert routing to fp16 variant.

Maya: opening incident ticket and setting SLA P1. ticket: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ML-1234

Anita: adding failing examples for postmortem. Example prompt: "Explain difference between var and let in JS"
quant output: "var is block scoped" (incorrect)
fp16 output: "var is function scoped" (correct)

Liam: plan: 1) rollback routing to fp16 for prod 2) reproduce locally 3) ablate quantization steps 4) check tokenizer/embedding versions. Who will trigger rollback?

Maya: @infra-runner can you do rollback now? if not I'll escalate to infra oncall.

infra-runner: starting rollback to fp16 routing, ETA ~12m.

ops-bot: scheduled rollback job started at ts=1767654368

Anita: I'll keep running reruns and post findings here. If we can isolate a prompt pattern we can add a targeted fix to the quant pipeline.

Maya: owners: Anita (primary), Liam (secondary), infra-runner (rollback). Updates every 30m. :thumbsup:

Anita: update +30m: reruns confirm gap persists across seeds 12-16. Sample failing prompt/output pair attached in rerun artifact: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/runs/1767654321/sample-fails.json

Liam: copying in ML-quant channel for deeper investigation and notifying model-owner. Will start quant ablation tomorrow morning if rollback completes.

infra-runner: rollback completed at ts=1767654390. Routing now points to model-x-fp16@v2 for production. Observability: latency and error budgets normalizing.

ops-bot: rollback verified by canary tests at ts=1767654405 — production pass.

Maya: great work team. Keep logging failing prompts and we'll include in postmortem. Next update in 1h or earlier if we find root cause.
